fmtNumber bridge (web L7,L48,L62): web fmtNumber(v, decimals?, locale?) reads a settings-derived global locale + precision and produces a locale-aware fixed-decimals string. Reproduced as useFmtNumber() over the shared useFormatPrefs(): fmtNumber(value, decimals?) = fmtNumberRaw(value, decimals ?? precision, locale). Both source call sites pass explicit decimals (L48 -> 2, L62 -> 0), so precision is only the documented fallback; nullish/NaN -> 0 via fmtNumberRaw's safeNumber, matching web fmtNumber. Wrapped in useCallback over [locale, precision] so it is reference-stable and the stats memo stays stable. No SI unit-suffixed field is added; this is a pure display formatter.
